text: Philip Pullman's The Golden Compass was pulled in 2007 from St. John Neumann Middle and Lourdes High School in Oshkosh, WI, over concerns about what critics called its "anti-Christian message." In 2008 it was removed from library shelves at dozens of schools in the publicly funded Halton (Ontario, Canada) Catholic School District, after a challenge alleging that it was "written by an atheist where the characters and text are anti-God, anti-Catholic, and anti-religion"; it was later returned. The publicly funded Calgary (Alberta, Canada) Catholic School District ordered its removal after detractors accused it of anti-religious content, then returned it to library shelves two months later.
meta_description: The Golden Compass by Philip Pullman was pulled in Oshkosh, WI, in 2007 and removed, then returned, in Halton and Calgary Catholic school districts in Canada.
